title: Gators No. 24 in First CFP Top 25 as Miami, Georgia Lead the Way
excerpt: Florida (5-3) is No. 24 in the first College Football Playoff rankings, one of 10 SEC teams in the Top 25. Miami, Georgia, Utah and Indiana hold the top four spots.

cover.alt: Graphic: First College Football Playoff Top 25 rankings, Nov. 3, 2026 — Florida Gators No. 24, one of 10 SEC teams in the Top 25. GatorBait Media.

blocks.text: The first College Football Playoff rankings of the 2026 season are out, and the Florida Gators are in them, with everything still in front of them.

runs.t: The first College Football Playoff rankings of the 2026 season are out, and the Florida Gators are in them, with everything still in front of them.

blocks.text: Florida (5-3) checked in at No. 24 in the selection committee's first Top 25, released Tuesday night. The Gators are one of 10 SEC teams in the rankings, the most of any conference.

runs.t: Florida (5-3) checked in at No. 24 in the selection committee's first Top 25, released Tuesday night. The Gators are one of 10 SEC teams in the rankings, the most of any conference.

blocks.alt: Graphic: Gators No. 24 in the first College Football Playoff Top 25, Nov. 3, 2026. Florida is 5-3 and one of 10 SEC teams ranked; Oklahoma visits Saturday at 7:45 p.m. ET on SEC Network. GatorBait Media

blocks.text: Miami (8-0) took the No. 1 spot, followed by Georgia (7-1), Utah (8-0) and Indiana (8-1). Those four would earn the first-round byes if the playoff started today.

runs.t: Miami (8-0) took the No. 1 spot, followed by Georgia (7-1), Utah (8-0) and Indiana (8-1). Those four would earn the first-round byes if the playoff started today.

blocks.text: The rest of the top 12: No. 5 Alabama (6-2), No. 6 Kentucky (7-1), No. 7 Texas (6-2), No. 8 UCLA (8-0), No. 9 BYU (7-1), No. 10 Ole Miss (6-2), No. 11 Notre Dame (7-1) and No. 12 Ohio State (6-2). Because No. 25 Boise State (7-1) is the highest-ranked Group of Six team, the Broncos would take the 12th spot in the bracket, leaving Ohio State and No. 13 Tennessee as the first two teams out.

blocks.text: Florida's road is narrow, but it is real. The Gators host Oklahoma on Saturday at 7:45 p.m. ET on SEC Network, and a win there starts the climb. The committee releases new rankings every Tuesday night, with the final 12-team field announced Sunday, Dec. 6.
